items.title: Ethereum fixes Glamsterdam bug that could have sent staking deposits to builders
items.body: Developers initially rejected the change before reversing course, as testing delays gave them more time to examine a flaw in Ethereum's upcoming Glamsterdam upgrade.

items.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine favors share buybacks to ether purchases as crypto declines
items.body: The Ethereum treasury firm spent $46 million buying back shares as Chairman Tom Lee said crypto has held up better than AI stocks during the recent market pullback.

items.title: AI agents help rescue ETH’s Glamsterdam fork, ‘Steal My Bitcoin’ site: Hodler’s Digest

items.title: Ethereum Delays Glamsterdam Testnet Fork Over Gas Security Flaws
items.body: The Hoodi testnet fork is off after ChainSecurity found gas changes that could let contracts lock in failures, citing 13 real-world cases.
